notes.title: The Fruit Mountain Soundtrack Is Here! Get the Main Game + Soundtrack Bundle!
notes.content: [h2]Fruit Mountain ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK – Now Available[/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3891090/_ORIGINAL_SOUNDTRACK/"][/dynamiclink]The long-awaited soundtrack featuring the in-game music from [i]Fruit Mountain[/i] is now available! It includes 7 tracks in total, featuring the main BGM with a full loop running over 7 minutes.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/57386/_/"][/dynamiclink]In addition, we’ve prepared a special bundle that includes both the main game and the soundtrack! This bundle is available at 15% off the regular price, making it a great deal![/p][p][/p][h3][/h3][p][/p][h2]Fruit Mountain Party Early Access Now Live![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905394/746e9b2f704249ff76434944864be4899d61d269.png"][/img]The brand-new competitive title [i]Fruit Mountain Party[/i], reborn from the original [i]Fruit Mountain[/i], has finally launched in Early Access![/p][p][/p][p][i]Fruit Mountain Party[/i] retains the core rule of merging the same type of fruit to make them bigger, while adding strategic use of various items and heated mind games. It’s a competitive party game you can enjoy solo or with up to four players.[/p][p]In the Early Access version, you’ll find a variety of game modes, dozens of new fruit types, a room feature that lets you battle with any player, and even support for Remote Play Together—so you can play with friends who don’t own the game![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]🔻For more details, please see the Steam News post below🔻[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3467540/view/538863491448045674"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]🔻Purchase here🔻[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3467540/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

tags.feature: The long-awaited soundtrack featuring the in-game music from Fruit Mountain is now available! It includes 7 tracks in total, featuring the main BGM with a full loop running over 7 minutes.
In addition, we’ve prepared a special bundle that includes both the main game and the soundtrack! This bundle is available at 15% off the regular price, making it a great deal!
The brand-new competitive title Fruit Mountain Party, reborn from the original Fruit Mountain, has finally launched in Early Access!

In the Early Access version, you’ll find a variety of game modes, dozens of new fruit types, a room feature that lets you battle with any player, and even support for Remote Play Together—so you can play with friends who don’t own the game!
